name: application-breadcrumb-page-header
title: Breadcrumb Page Header
description: Page-header composite — a breadcrumb trail, page title, optional description, and a trailing action slot for buttons.
useWhen: Starting a detail or list page that sits several levels deep in navigation and benefits from a breadcrumb trail above the title.
The page needs primary and/or secondary actions positioned consistently in the header, not scattered in the body.
You want the standard title + description + breadcrumb block to be a single reusable unit rather than hand-assembled per page.
avoidWhen: The page is top-level with no meaningful parent trail — a bare title without `breadcrumbs` is simpler and avoids a one-item trail.
You only need the breadcrumb trail on its own, not bundled with a title/actions block — use `breadcrumbs` directly.
The header needs tabs or a more complex sub-navigation row — extend this pattern rather than overloading the actions slot with navigation.
responsiveBehavior: Title/description and actions share a flex row that can wrap actions below the title on narrow viewports if the actions slot contains more than 1-2 buttons.
accessibility: The breadcrumb trail is a <nav> with an aria-label distinguishing it from primary site navigation, per the `breadcrumbs` component's own pattern.
The current page in the trail carries aria-current="page" rather than being a link, since it isn't a navigable target.
The title is a real <h1>, establishing the page's primary heading for assistive tech and document outline tools.
Chevron separators between breadcrumb items are aria-hidden, decorative only.

variants.title: Breadcrumb Page Header
variants.description: Three-level breadcrumb trail, page title and description, and two trailing action buttons.
accessibility: Breadcrumb link/current-page rendering is computed from real array position, so it stays correct as trails are extended or shortened.

variants.title: Breadcrumb Page Header (Dark)
variants.description: Breadcrumb page header adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and border colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
